title: Inexpensive Alternative to Custom Table Pad Protects Against Spills
text:
Inexpensive Alternative to Custom Table Pad Protects Against Spills. This BENSON MILLS DELUXE VINYL TABLE PAD can easily be cut with scissors to fit any table that is smaller than the 52" x 90" dimensions given on the package. Placed between a finished wooden tabletop and a tablecloth, it provides an extra layer of protection from spills--particularly those horrible rings caused by water and wine glasses.

This table pad is made of thin white vinyl that is backed by a thin layer of flannel. It's no beauty--you will always want to cover it with a tablecloth. It should reasonably protect a tabletop from hot dishes, because it doesn't catch fire immediately when a lighted match is placed directly on the vinyl surface. However, the lighted match, if left there, does melt the vinyl and burn a hole, so the table pad won't protect against cigarette burns.

The flannel backing is a good idea, because it prevents the vinyl from getting permanently stuck to the finished (varnished) tabletop. However, the flannel backing also causes the protective pad to slide around on the tabletop. A tablecloth will help hold the pad in place, but a thin table pad like this one lacks the weight it needs to stay firmly in position.

This 52" x 90" table pad (about $20 on Amazon) is an inexpensive alternative to a custom table pad, and offers good protection against ordinary spills. However, because I wouldn't want to rely on it to protect a tabletop that I really cared a lot about, I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

features: HEAVY DUTY TABLE PROTECTOR: Protect your table from spills, scratches, and heat with this vinyl Table Pad with soft flannel backing. This Table Cover provides a protective barrier for your elegant table or other surfaces desired to protect. Our dining room Table Cover is made of high quality premium water-resistant vinyl on top and it is backed with flannel to provide a soft material to contact with the surface of your table.

HIGH QUALITY: Our Table Pad Protector is made up of 100% Vinyl and 100% Polyester Flannel Backing The flannel backing features an extra-thick polyester backing that provides a soft, resilient scratch-less layer for protection. The top layer Vinyl and bottom Flannel layer quilted together provide your table with a thick protective pad. Preserve and protect your table for years to come with this premium Table Cover.

DURABLE and WATERPROOF: Our Table Pad for your home table is very durable and lasts for many years. The embossed vinyl surface adds a decorative touch if used alone. Our Table Pad is liquid-proof, preventing spills from damaging tabletop surfaces from all kinds of spills. The table protector is very easy to clean.

CUSTOMIZE FOR YOUR SIZE TABLE: This Vinyl Table Pad is perfect for use under your favorite tablecloth and comes in a variety of sizes to choose from. Cuts easily to fit your desired table size or shape. It can be easily customized to fit your desired surface area to needing protection. Folds easily to be to stored conveniently.
description: Deluxe vinyl table pad that protects your table from spills and wipes clean with a damp cloth.
